priority: Decode toward 100 ms/token and 10 token/s without MTP

inventory.tensor_order_for_hashes: numeric layer ascending, then gate, then up

format.name: Delta4-Row32-Fallback-v1
format.compressed_row_base: minimum raw E4M3 byte in the 32-value row tile
format.fallback_contract: If the row predicate fails, metadata byte is 0x80, both stored nibbles for that row are fixed to zero, and the decoder reads that row's retained canonical aligned 32-byte sector.
format.metadata_layout: [row_quad][K512_tile][row_within_quad] as one little-endian uint32 per tile; pass bytes are the raw base below 0x80 and fallback bytes are 0x80
format.code_byte_contract: For each lane-pair and row, low nibble is column lane_pair minus base and high nibble is column 16+lane_pair minus base.
format.roundtrip: bit exact for every one of the 713031680 raw E4M3 bytes; zero mismatches in the host scan

all_tensor_scan.scan_manifest_contract: Each of 128 rows contains layer, projection, source SHA-256, compressed and fallback row counts, code SHA-256, metadata SHA-256, and tensor-record SHA-256; JSON canonicalization uses sorted keys and compact separators.

decoder_topology_and_sector_model.code_load: For each tile, lanes 0..15 issue one aligned uint32 load each. The 64 contiguous bytes request exactly two 32-byte sectors. All lanes obtain their lane-pair uint32 through one shuffle from source lane>>1.
decoder_topology_and_sector_model.phase_decode: Inside each of the two existing phases, select the low or high nibble directly from the broadcast lane-pair word, add the four packed base bytes, and thereby avoid the canonical partner-XOR scale shuffle.
decoder_topology_and_sector_model.metadata_preload: At the start of each row quad, lanes 0..9 load the ten contiguous uint32 metadata words. Every 40-byte row-quad span requests exactly two 32-byte sectors for all ten tiles, or 0.2 request sectors per tile; one shuffle selects the current tile word.
decoder_topology_and_sector_model.fallback_load: Each failed row adds exactly one known-address canonical 32-byte sector; no sparse raw stream, prefix directory, bitmap rank, ballot, or popcount is used.
decoder_topology_and_sector_model.sector_accounting_excludes: The common decoded-scale table, checksum/output traffic in a standalone decoder, and packed NVFP4 weights are unchanged and cancel in the candidate comparison.

traffic_ceiling.classification: capacity and physical-sector admission only; neither ceiling is an achieved CUDA or end-to-end speedup

tensor_base_delta6.result: closed as the already measured scale6 mechanism
tensor_base_delta6.reason: All 30 formal gate/up rounds regressed; this admission may not rename or retry the same six-bit cross-word unpack.

whole_tile_delta4_with_raw_fallback.result: reject because the entire physical ceiling is consumed by the target before decode work

whole_tile_delta5_with_raw_fallback.result: reject because it retains scale6-like cross-word unpack, adds per-tile base metadata, and requests more L1 sectors than scale6

shared_p15_code_with_direct_canonical_ex.result: reject because sparse known-address canonical exception loads already exceed canonical traffic before decode

shared_p15_position_raw_pairs_threshold7.result: reject in favor of Delta4-Row32 because every regular tile needs three sectors and up to seven pair broadcasts and compares

shared_p15_bitmap.result: reject because bitmap rank reintroduces ballot/popcount or equivalent prefix work already rejected by P15E while using more bytes

shared_p31_code5_with_direct_canonical_e.result: reject without another CUDA implementation because its three L1 sectors match scale6, its five-bit cross-word decoder is not materially lighter, and its best conservative decoder budget is lower than Delta4-Row32

shared_p63_or_code6.result: reject as dominated by exact tensor-base scale6: the same 96-byte and three-sector code stream adds a palette lookup without removing cross-word unpack

direct_e4m3_seven_bit_field.result: reject because the 112-byte tile still requests four sectors and adds bit unpack to canonical E4M3 reconstruction

test_only_decoder_gate.scope: production-unreachable standalone canonical versus Delta4-Row32 decoder and sector screen on actual layer 0 and layer 50 gate/up pairs
test_only_decoder_gate.required_host_correctness: reproduce the frozen source, code, metadata, and tensor-record SHA-256 values and zero mismatches
test_only_decoder_gate.required_device_correctness: full payload bit exact for pass and fallback rows, guards intact, inputs and sidecars immutable
test_only_decoder_gate.required_code_path: one aligned 64-byte code request per tile, one row-quad metadata preload for ten tiles, direct phase nibble selection, known-address canonical row fallback, and no explicit ballot, popcount, prefix rank, variable directory, or sparse raw stream
test_only_decoder_gate.sector_tolerance_reason: The limit allows 32 constant overhead sectors beyond the frozen scale-payload formula for a standalone checksum fixture.
test_only_decoder_gate.stop_loss: If layer 0 or layer 50 fails correctness, resources, measured sectors, any-round non-regression, or the 4.6875-us median gate, delete the standalone candidate and do not implement a full gate/up kernel or production sidecar.

decision.reason: This is the only audited format that both clears a 0.30-ms physical ceiling and removes P15E rank/directory work while offering a decoder materially lighter than scale6.

claim_limits: This record admits one test-only decoder/sector screen. It is not a CUDA timing result, full gate/up kernel result, end-to-end result, or production speedup.
The 1.136086-ms and 1.216835-ms values are traffic-only ceilings using 165.567 GB/s; actual instruction, dependency, cache, fallback, and integration costs can consume them.
Canonical scales remain required for Prefill and fallback rows, so 361.25 MiB would be additional resident memory if all sidecars were later selected.
The full 128-row manifest and encoded sidecars were hashed in memory and not retained; the aggregate hashes and frozen layer 0/layer 50 hashes identify the exact scan contract.
MTP is explicitly excluded from this candidate and from the current 100-ms/token path.
